name: ai-infra-plugins
description: Curated Claude Code plugins for AI infrastructure engineering, including GPU kernels, compilers, runtimes, benchmarking, and model serving systems.

plugins.name: cuda
plugins.description: Comprehensive reference for NVIDIA CUDA C++ covering Programming Guide and Best Practices Guide (v13.2), including programming model, memory management, async execution, CUDA graphs, cooperative groups, TMA unit, L2 cache control, virtual memory, IPC, multi-GPU, and performance optimization.

plugins.name: cutile
plugins.description: NVIDIA cuTile tile-based GPU programming model reference covering tile kernels, tile operations, TileIR compiler, array-based CUDA programming, tile-level parallelism, AOT compilation, autotuning, memory model, atomic operations, and interoperability with CuPy/PyTorch/NumPy.

plugins.name: cutlass
plugins.description: Comprehensive NVIDIA CUTLASS/CuTe GPU kernel development reference covering GEMM, convolution, epilogue fusion, tensor layouts, pipeline management, and Python API with detailed code-level guidance.

plugins.name: flash-attention
plugins.description: Complete reference for FlashAttention - fast and memory-efficient exact attention with IO-awareness. Covers FA2, FA3 (Hopper), FA4 (CuTeDSL) APIs, multi-head attention module, model implementations, operations library, Triton kernels, and training framework integration.

plugins.name: pytorch
plugins.description: Comprehensive reference for PyTorch (v2.7) covering tensor operations, autograd, nn modules, distributed training, CUDA support, AMP, torch.compile/Dynamo, TorchScript, FX, Inductor, ONNX export, quantization, profiling, sparse tensors, C++ API (libtorch), and deployment.

plugins.name: tilelang
plugins.description: Comprehensive reference for TileLang - a concise DSL for developing high-performance GPU/CPU kernels built on Apache TVM. Covers 3-level abstraction, language API, compilation pipeline, JIT system, backends (CUDA/ROCm/Metal/CPU/WebGPU), layout system, quantization, autotuning, and extensive examples.

plugins.name: triton
plugins.description: Comprehensive reference for OpenAI Triton (v3.7) - a language and compiler for writing highly efficient custom Deep-Learning primitives on GPUs. Covers Python API, MLIR dialects, backends (NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm), experimental features, Proton profiler, tutorials, and build system.

plugins.name: tvm
plugins.description: Comprehensive reference for Apache TVM machine learning compilation framework covering TensorIR, Relax IR, TVMScript, MetaSchedule, DLight, model import, GPU/CPU code generation, operator fusion, auto-tuning, BYOC, dataflow pattern language, LLM optimization, and distributed inference.

plugins.name: xla
plugins.description: Comprehensive reference for XLA (Accelerated Linear Algebra, v2.0) compiler covering architecture, operation semantics, HLO IR, compilation pipeline, GPU/CPU/TPU backends, PJRT API, MLIR integration, custom calls, autotuning, SPMD partitioning, debugging tools, and build system.
